header.running_head: The Da'wah that The Sahabah (RA) Gave to Individuals

blocks.text: Islaam and started inviting people to Islaam. When this news reached Safwaan, he said, "When he went to his family before coming to me, I knew that Umayr had become involved in the very thing he feared and had forsaken his religion. I shall never speak to him again and never do a good turn to him or his family."

As Safwaan stood in the Hateem one day, Hadhrat Umayr (RA) called for him. When Safwaan ignored him, Hadhrat Umayr (RA) said to him, "You are one of our leaders. Tell me. When we worshipped stones and sacrificed animals for them, was this any religion? I testify that there is none worthy of worship but Allaah and that Muhammad ﷺ is Allaah's servant and Rasul." Safwaan did not utter a word in response.[^1] The effort Hadhrat Umayr (RA) made to get Safwaan to accept Islaam has already been mentioned.[^2]
Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) Gives Da'wah to his Mother and She Accepts Islaam

blocks.arabic_text: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) says that he used to invite his mother to Islaam when she was still a Mushrik. One day as he was giving her the Da'wah, she told him things about Rasulullaah ﷺ that he did not like. He went crying to Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! When I invite my mother to Islaam, she refuses to accept. When I did so today, she told me things about you that I did not like. Pray to Allaah to guide the mother of Abu Hurayra." Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! Guide the mother of Abu Hurayra." Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) narrates further, "Happy with the du'aa of Rasulullaah ﷺ, I left but when I tried to open the door of the house, I found it locked. Hearing my footsteps, my mother shouted, 'Stay where you are, O Abu Hurayra.' I then heard the pattering of water (as my mother took a bath to accept Islaam). She then wore her clothes and hastily donned a scarf. She opened the door and said, 'O Abu Hurayra! 'I testify that there is none worthy of worship but Allaah and that Muhammad ﷺ is Allaah's Rasul.'" Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) says that he then returned to Rasulullaah ﷺ and informed him about what had happened. Rasulullaah ﷺ praised Allaah and made du'aa in their favour.[^3]

According to another narration, Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) used to say, "By Allaah! Whenever any male or female Muslim hears my name, they take a liking to me." "How do you know this?" the narrator asked. He then mentioned that he used to invite his mother to Islaam and the narration continues like the one mentioned above.
